tagline: Quality outdoor power equipment from trusted brands, locally owned
heroSubheading: Quality equipment and expert service for all your outdoor needs.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Oamaru, family-owned and serving the community for over 48 years. Brad Selfe and the team stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda, and Hansa Chippers, with genuine expertise across every brand.

Whether you need new equipment, a service or repair, parts, or advice on what suits your place, come and talk to us. We know our products well and enjoy helping locals find the right tool for the job.

We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings 9am to 12pm. You can visit us in store or shop online for home delivery or click and collect.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Home delivery and click and collect
